assignment.algorithm: Rank cases and participants by SHA-256 using the frozen assignment seed; assign condition_index=(case_rank+participant_rank) mod 3.
assignment.balance_rule: For each case and participant, condition counts differ by at most one; with participant count divisible by three, every case has exactly equal condition counts.

dropout.after_any_evaluated_exposure: Do not reassign completed or pending cells. Preserve the participant and records. If any case then lacks at least one terminal record in a required condition, invalidate the study version; otherwise report the imbalance.
dropout.before_any_evaluated_exposure: Remove the participant, freeze a new roster version, and regenerate the entire assignment before exposure.

required_attestations: Can read JSON configuration diffs and reason about allow/ask/deny/default-mode changes.
Has working familiarity with Claude Code project settings and the frozen permission-semantics documentation supplied by the study.
Can distinguish widening, restriction/equivalence, and unresolved semantics without inventing undocumented runtime behavior.

training.allowed_questions: Questions may clarify the frozen procedure, decision vocabulary, documentation snapshots, timing rules, and PermitDiff output field meanings. Questions about any evaluated case are forbidden before that participant submits the case.

field_orientation: PermitDiff raw JSON report field orientation without evaluated-case content

worked_examples.explanation: The candidate adds declared preapproval authority.
The change is restrictive within the frozen directional construct.
The supplied frozen semantics do not establish the custom matcher ordering without undocumented assumptions.

training.stopping_rule: Complete all three frozen worked examples and the field-orientation section exactly once; no additional case-specific training is allowed.
training.timing: Complete once after eligibility approval and before condition assignment or evaluated exposure.
